mapper.insert: INSERT INTO remediation_action ( action_id, session_id, title, action_type, target_resource, risk_level, command, rollback_plan, status, approval_comment, approved_by, execution_log, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{actionId}, #{sessionId}, #{title}, #{actionType}, #{targetResource}, #{riskLevel}, #{command}, #{rollbackPlan}, #{status}, #{approvalComment}, #{approvedBy}, #{executionLog}, now(), now() )
mapper.select: SELECT id, action_id, session_id, title, action_type, target_resource, risk_level, command, rollback_plan, status, approval_comment, approved_by, execution_log, create_time, update_time FROM remediation_action WHERE action_id = #{actionId}

SELECT id, action_id, session_id, title, action_type, target_resource, risk_level, command, rollback_plan, status, approval_comment, approved_by, execution_log, create_time, update_time FROM remediation_action WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY create_time ASC

SELECT id, action_id, session_id, title, action_type, target_resource, risk_level, command, rollback_plan, status, approval_comment, approved_by, execution_log, create_time, update_time FROM remediation_action WHERE status = 'PROPOSED' ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE remediation_action SET status = #{status}, approved_by = #{approvedBy}, approval_comment = #{approvalComment}, update_time = now() WHERE action_id = #{actionId}
UPDATE remediation_action SET status = #{status}, execution_log = #{executionLog}, update_time = now() WHERE action_id = #{actionId}
